profile.name: Keithley 7999-6 开关设备
profile.description: Keithley 7999-6 是一款可编程电信号开关/切换设备，用于实验室自动化测试中在不同通道、仪器和被测件之间进行信号路由与切换，适合多路复用和测量切换场景。
profile.description_en: The Keithley 7999-6 is a programmable electrical switching instrument used in laboratory automation to route and switch signals between channels, instruments, and devices under test. It is suited for multiplexing and measurement switching applications.
